id: list-paths
title: "List process paths"
description: "Returns only Active paths by default — matching the retired YAML catalogue's own posture that every consumer's normal read is 'the currently valid set,' not everything that ever existed. Pass ?all=true for the audit view (Active and Deactivated paths). The list is keyset-paginated (REST guideline section 3): `limit` (1-500, default 100) and an opaque `cursor`, in pathId order (the unique key); the answer is `{items, nextCursor}` and `nextCursor` is absent on the last page. Filters (`all`) are repeated on every page request. Any query parameter other than `all`, `limit` and `cursor` is 400 `unknown-query-parameter` (a retired paging parameter such as `after` or `offset` fails loudly instead of reading page one forever)."

<MethodEndpoint

  path={"/process-paths"}

>

Returns only Active paths by default — matching the retired YAML catalogue's own posture that every consumer's normal read is "the currently valid set," not everything that ever existed. Pass ?all=true for the audit view (Active and Deactivated paths). The list is keyset-paginated (REST guideline section 3): `limit` (1-500, default 100) and an opaque `cursor`, in pathId order (the unique key); the answer is `{items, nextCursor}` and `nextCursor` is absent on the last page. Filters (`all`) are repeated on every page request. Any query parameter other than `all`, `limit` and `cursor` is 400 `unknown-query-parameter` (a retired paging parameter such as `after` or `offset` fails loudly instead of reading page one forever).
